ocr_full_text_page: to cap all the factors which are contributing towards water depletion such as water wastage, overconsumption and increasing water pollution. Instrumental steps such as implementation of water conservation techniques and multiplication of water dams - number are needed more than ever to ensure that present and the future generations of all life forms are not deprived of the core resource that sustains their existence. - The proverb, " Do not waste water even if you are standing at a running Stream" is an iconic lesson from the history. Since the ancient times, water has always been considered "sacred" There used to be oldest civilizations that only thrived because of their proximity to the water source. CS CamScanner
